title: Aeolus sensor catalog
description: Maps raw SMC keys to human-readable labels, scoped by chip family and Mac model. The catalog only decorates: sensor discovery is dynamic, and a machine with no catalog entries at all still shows every sensor it has, unlabelled and fully usable. Validated in CI on every pull request.

key.description: The raw four-character SMC key, e.g. Tp09.

match.description: Restricts this entry to specific hardware. An entry with no match applies everywhere, which should be rare — most keys mean different things on different chips.

label.description: The human-readable name. Always displayed alongside the raw key, never instead of it.

confidence.description: How much this label should be trusted. Shown in the UI. 'verified' means someone confirmed the mapping against observed behaviour on that hardware; 'guess' is displayed as a guess so a wrong label cannot quietly mislead someone into a bad fan curve.

source.description: Where the mapping came from — an issue number, a pull request, or a citation. Required in practice for 'verified'.
